text: Great product. Arrived as promised and perfectly covers the stove-countertop gap.
excellent product.  exactly what i was looking for. flexible for a good fit. thank you!

These came quickly, and they do the job, but I think they're a little pricey. About a week after I received them, I accidentally found the same item in a brick-and-mortar home furnishings chain for $6.99 for one. That's a considerable savings even if you're buying two. Check stores in your area first, and if you can't find them, then order online.
Works great.
Is very good easy to clean fit well between my stove and the counter, i wanted a clear one but the white maches the stove. I'm very satisfied.
Excellent product, Fast shipping!! A+++

Exactly what I needed for the kitchen.  Think about it, who likes it when crumbs or oil falls between the stove and counter making it a chore to clean.  This stops the drips, leaks and "crummage"  Would recommend
These stove gap seals were just what I was looking for.  Perfect!

These are just okay. Can't keep them from sliding around on contact. I have scrupulously cleaned both surfaces and even tried gently heating the strips to get some "cohesion". Nope. I have contemplated gluing them down. Any suggestions on the adhesive?
great product delivered quickly!
They're a little short and don't stick to the counter as I had hoped. Silicon...soft sleek looking, but they flip out of place often.
The silicone insertion piece is flimsy and if the space is too tight, it doesn't fit in between the range and the counter.

Great idea!!! No more important stuff falling in between the counters and stove!!!

Fantastic!
Seals fit beautifully, even on the side of stove that is a little higher than the counter.  They are pure white and look great.  I would purchase again.
Delivered as describe......

I cook a lot! There were always a lot of spills and crumbs between my counters and my stove.  This solved the problem completely. They are very easy to put in place and clean. I've recommended it to friends and family.

Received promptly from supplier & not only well packed but they were flat in their product box - not wound up in a circle & contorted - so all I had to do was wipe off & install. They are soft & flexible & the little bit of extra depth in the seal's downward filler is nice (I'd think especially if you're dealing with uneven heights in stove top & counter). Also, they are a True White color - so they blend in exceptionally well with stove.
They serve their purpose, they just don't look as lovely as I would have liked and they do flap up when cleaning but no junk has fallen between the creases since i put them on.
the stove gap seals are good but they should have been 3 inches longer.  They do not fit the length of the counter.  Thank you Claire Dorr
These silicone seals are perfect. They fit, don't slide around like metal ones do and are good looking.
Product is fantastic fits as described, I am very very very happy with my purchase.

These are great! I bought a set of black and a set of white. We a 2 stand alone stoves in two different locations. The black fit perfectly. The white stove is a little bit different, but I was able to trim the seals to fit! They are very easy to clean! And they don't slide around!
Product is as described and I received my set of gap seals when expected.

These stove gap seals are soft, not sharp on the edges like some others. They are very high quality. I am very glad I bought them. I received an email from the company that sells them asking if I received them and if I like them. Yes and yes!
We found they work best for us installed upside down.

What a terrific gizmo this is! Day one I managed to slop over half a pot of soup and not a single drop went down into the stove gap abyss. The stovetop and adjoining countertop were a mess. After cleaning up my spill, I crossed my fingers, removed the gap seal and pulled out the stove - just to be sure - and it did exactly what it was designed to do. Hurray! Sure wish I'd discovered these sooner as I am a real klutz in the kitchen.

The pair of gap seals arrive flat in a long box, so you don't have to steam them or take any measures to flatten them back out after shipping. Their silicone construction makes them tough enough for using near the burner, and they easily wash up with a little soap and water. They fit nicely between the control panel on the stove to the front of the stovetop and are very unobtrusive in appearance. I was afraid they would look like I had duct-taped the seam, but, happily, that was not the case. Mine were in place for several days before my very observant hubby even noticed them.

Sure glad that I invested in these little timesavers - today's disaster was a whipped up raw egg that landed right on top of the gap seal. Again, not a bit went into the gap. YAY!
Look nice, easy to clean and so far they are working as I wanted.  Thanks!
My wife is very pleased with the quality of these gap seals.
Good price, good product, good value

I really like this one, better than the steel plate one I ordered 5 years ago.
I could cut this one to fit my countertop and stove, it was so cool.
Gap seals are every bit what they were advertised. Very flexible and stay in place. Would highly recommend them.
I bought this product to fill the gap between my new gas stove and the adjacent counters. The seals fit easily in place. They appear to be stain resistant and very easy to clean.
These are perfect!  Exactly what we were looking for due to the different sizes between the counter and the stove.  We like it so well we'll be purchasing another set to send to family in Nebraska.
They work perfectly, just what i hoped for, and i got 2! Great product
Easily installed, good grip and so far no slipping issues... just wish there was a 24" version.
Easily installed, good grip and so far no slipping issues... just wish there was a 24" version.

It's amazing what a goopy mess 2 little ounces of fat-free half and half can make when it gets accidentally tipped over and drizzles down between the range top and the adjacent cabinet. Yuck! I ordered these within the hour! Two days later I have them, they're installed, and I think I can safely say never again! They fit really well in spite of a pretty big difference in height between the range top and countertop. They seem quite secure, and yay! No more gap!
Just installed them too son to rate for performance.
A little flimsier than I expected. After slight trimming it will fit better.
Pleased....makes cooking a little more ,"user friendly "!

We used them in a cabin that we rent to the public.  Our housekeeper noticed that the edge of the strip that was over the lip on the stove was "wrinkling" a bit, so she took the silicone strip and held it a little closer to flame and it caught fire.  Wow!

Arrived promptly. Packaging was perfect. Fit and "performance" --just what i was looking for!
Thank You so much!!
Does the job!

These work and look great! I was rolling up paper towels and sticking them in the gaps between my stove and the countertops but these are soooo much better, they look a whole lot nicer and they are easy to clean. I should have done this a long time ago!
Excellent size fit and finish.
does and looks exactly as I expected. Too soon to check longevity

The lip on the countertop side is rather large so I trimmed it down with an exacto knife such that both sides were even.  I have very little gap between the stove and counter so the additional coverage was not necessary for my situation.  So far they have been easy to clean and have stayed white and seem self-sealing.  I would purchase these again.  This is not a biased review.  I received nothing discounted or free.  If I could do 4.5 stars I would since I do wish they were slightly longer.
simple, easy to clean, Great Product!  I love this brilliant product!
Amazing product and just perfect for my new stove.  I was horrified when I saw the sides of my old one when they pulled it out.  Thanks so much.

Love the idea - glad to have them. They stick out onto counter a bit further than I'd like (on the long side),but I might trim them. Doesn't stick to counter top very well. Would also like the option to have a clear version. My counter is an off-white, so these kind of stand out. Also might consider rounded edges for a more finished look on the front end. Would be nice to have more of a bevel where the wide side meets the counter so that it tapers down (might also stick to counter better if it were thinner on the edge?) Great idea though. Looking forward to keeping spills from going down the side of the stove. Any suggestions for how to get it to stick to counter better?
The seals are perfect! Our counter are has a weird gap so we were able to cut the second one to fit perfectly. Quick shipping too!
I like them.
Seals fit perfectly.  Looking forward to not having crumbs and whatever going down between the stove and counter.
worked very good

Seconds to install, looks fine on our brand-new KitchenAid. After a day you don't notice it. Both sticky - it doesn't move around - and slippery, so clean-up is simple. A thousand (or more) dollars cheaper than a slide-in range!
Thank you! The stove gap seal worked perfectly. Easy to clean!
Works great!  Stops everything, crumbs, cooking spills from going between the stove and the cupboards!  Easy peasy clean up!
The stove top gap seals were even better than I expected! I am extremely pleased...thank you so much!!
closes the gap
Easy to cut to size and fit well and does what it is supposed to.
Worked well for what I needed I had to cut them to fit exactly for my situation but they were very easy to work with and I am very happy with the result. Easy to order and arrived promptly thank you.
The gap covers will not work at all if there is any slight height difference between the stove and counter.
These seals are great! Non-slip and a great fit! Easy to clean and arrived quickly. Great customer service, thank you! :)

Very pleased with these.  Didn't have to cut them to size and they slipped right into place.  Not a chance of food or spills ever collecting on the sides of these, unlike other ones we've had.  We had the kind with a magnetic strip before, and they, subjectively, may look a bit nicer, but gunk still collected on the edges of them  and because of the magnetic strip you can't just pull them out to clean.  They may work fine with another stove/counter combination than ours, I'm just making the point that these wider seals that simply cover the gap completely, and can easily be pulled out to clean, are finally what we've been looking for.  I was afraid they'd look tacky but the black strip with a black stove and sand-colored counters looks fine, you hardly notice them.
Very nice looking.  Just what I wanted.
Customer Service was great. Received items quickly and started using right away. Was exactly what I needed. Thank you.
They fit and work as expected.
They are great!  We are getting a new countertop, and after seeing what fell between the old counter and the stove....excuse me while I compose myself...these will be worth their weight in gold!

This is the solution to that dreaded gap between the stove and the kitchen counter, where bits of chopped up veggies, spills, and debris go to die and are impossible to clean up! These seals are flexible and sit perfectly in the gap. They are easy to wipe down and if need be, easy to give a good soaping. They are a god-send!
Do what they are suppose to but cumbersome and get drug out of place alot like when wiping down stove
These were exactly as pictured and just what I needed!

These do the job and look sharp (I bought the black to match my new gas range top). Easy to clean and they stay in place. I only wish they were longer; there is about 3/4 inch that isn't covered. Preferable would be to have it be longer and then cut to size. Hate to think of buying another one to "piece" it together as they'd probably not stick together and then look odd.

I made a great choice. I've been wanting to get buy a product like this for so long I'm very happy with these. They are made very good, fit perfect & look great. The packaging was excellent and they arrived faster than expected. I would recommend them both to family and friends.
Thank you Mary Lou Lion
Good strips to lay beside a stove between cabinets.  Keeps food and crud from going in between the two when cleaning up.
serves the purpose as intended.

Flimsy, cheap looking and very hard to clean. I bought the black one and you can see dust on it when it sits for about a week and it's hard to wipe off the dust and when you wipe it with a wet sponge, it leaves water marks very easily. Not long enough for my new kitchen.
Fills the gap very nocely and looks great!

The gap seals came today, only two days after I discovered them on Amazon. It is exactly what I wanted and needed to prevent crumbs from slipping between the counter and the stove. Tonight I showed them to visiting friends who, like myself not long ago, had no idea that there was such a thing. These silicone strips are shiny, fit nicely between stove and counter and almost look like part of our black stove. Even my husband was rather amazed that I found these miraculous strips and can count on a nice clean floor under our kitchen range. I'm a happy camper with this purchase.
Very good

I am very happy with the stove gap seals. They look good and fit perfectly.
Just what I needed for my new stove top. It grips well and not too tight or too loose to fill in the gap between the stove and counter space. Perfect length and good price!

Very satisfied with product. Fits perfectly flexible and great appearance
Works great

Wasn't sure I would like these, but I am really glad I purchased them. They are perfect for keeping spills and crumbs from falling down beside the stove.
Very pleased with the seals. Should have gotten these much sooner. No more gunk between the counter and stove.

These were about 3 inches shorter than my oven, and are about an inch wider than I was expecting. Still definitely helpful, but there is some missing coverage lengthwise, and unnecessary bulk widthwise.

I love these! They stay in place! They look very nice against my black glass top range and dark granite. They are easy to clean and fit, etc.
I was worried about the potential close proximity to the burners (5 rather than 4). I did not to need to worry for they're perfect.
Very very useful and such a clever product. Just had to be trimmed a little bit to fit!

Very moldable and easy to install. The black blends in with my stove/granite nicely. It slid right into the cracks and was installed in under 30 seconds. Only downside so far is that the rubber is very sticky, which is great for holding them in place, but also causes them to be dust/crumb/fuzzy magnets. They'll need to be washed regularly, which is not a big deal because I can wipe them down with my stove when I use it.
Perfect fit, just what I was looking for but the surface is smudgy looking in contrast with my shiny black stovetop and black granite.  I'm wondering what to use to shine it.
Black silicone ones are an improvement over the metal ones we had - they don't catch on things and stay in place.
Love my seals... they are shiny so they match the stove. They seem to wash easily when I wash off the stove. Fit perfectly.
Clean and simple. Great small detail addition for my kitchen.
Excellent product. Fits perfectly between the stove and the counter-top.

These are amazing! I ordered a black pair for myself and it blends so well with my stove.  I love how easy it is to clean and that it blocks the cracks between my stove better than when I covered it with foil.  I love these so much, I bought my mother and sister each a pair of their own and they love it too.
Met expectations

I received the black set a few days ago for the gaps btween the counter and stove and am very pleased with them. They completely fill the gap and don't slide around. They are very unobtrusive and clean easily.

Exactly what I needed & the perfect solution for preventing crumbs, grease & debris from dropping in between my stove & cabinets. The black is the perfect match for my new stainless & black stove & just wipes clean. Fits nicely & stays in place too.

Okay, I just put these on my stove and I think I really love them.  They are very flexible and so form a decent seal with the stove and the counter.  It remains to be seen how they hold up and whether they are a pain to clean when I wash my counters.  I think I like them much better than the stiff ones I have had in the past, and I DEFINITELY like them better than the gap.  They arrived in good condition and in a reasonable time.  The only thing I wasn't so happy about was Amazon's packaging - they and a few other small items arrived in a HUGE box.  That seemed rather wasteful.  But the product and this vendor, McClure's General Store, are great.  I recommend.
no comment
My husband has been at me for years to get these to stop the crumbs from going between the stove and countertop.  I love how they "cling" to the counter and stove and stay in place

perfect fit and just as described!

Excellent Product!!  My poor wife had crammed aluminum foil in the gaps to avoid my sloppiness as the amateur chef in our household.  So glad I looked around for an alternative.  The hardest part was what to use for Google search words.....Stove Gap Seals?????.......Who da thunk?!

What a wonderful invention.  No more dropping food into the "gap."  We have about 1/2" each side of our stove and these seals have covered it up.  They fit well, are very flexible and easy to clean.  You can trim them if the are a little too long or too wide.

We discovered after having a new range installed that there was a difference in height between the cabinets on either side of the range.  These gap seals are the perfect solution.  They stay where they are put, they mitigate the obvious difference in height of the cabinets and they eliminate the possibility anything will fall down in the gap.  The fact they look good, are dishwasher safe and are fairly heat resistant are just bonuses.
Serve their advertised purpose and are virtually invisible against the granite and stove top.
These are a great idea to keep things from spilling or crumbs from falling in between the crack of the stove and the counter. Easy to wipe clean.

Stove gap seals are as advertised.  They fit very well in the paper thin gap between the stove and counter.  The stove is about 1/4" lower than the counter and the seals adapt just fine.  The black color blends in quite well with the counter and stove.  Only con is that the surface is somewhat tacky and difficult to keep clean but I'm sure being tacky is what keeps them in place so well.  Certainly better than having crumbs accumulate between stove and counter top.

Gets the job done. Used it to close the gap between my stove and counter. I placed a very hot pan too close to the seal, and part of it (a very small part) burned, but that was my fault. My favorite thing about these is they're easy to clean.
Simple and easily installed gap filler for the stove. Should do the job well and be easy to clean, too.
Nice product won't show wear and looks like part of the ovem
Once I figured out just how to fit your Gap Seals (wide side on range or on counter) I am learning to appreciate them. They seal nicely to the surfaces.  Will be easy to clean and refit.

Great idea! They are long so I was able to trim them to fit perfectly. We bent ours and tucked one side down in order to hide an odd black strip on the counter and it still fills the gap. Only four stars because the silicone material attracts dust!  They had a small quantity of dust before I was done laying them out! Only a really big problem if you even brush it with a paper towel.
Great product. Just as expected
I bought black ones.  They work exactly as described and they look good.  Do not hesitate to buy them.
Love the flexibility to fit stove not level with counter top.

These are a nice thick soft plastic-type material and are much nicer than I actually expected them to be.  No measuring or trimming was needed. They are much wider than the gap which really makes them blend from the stove to the counter without looking like a separate thing.  They look like they belong there!!  Shipping /packaging was good and prompt.
